title: Doesn't fit how I expected.
text: Doesn't fit how I expected.. Allot of extra fabric in the sides making this cover look very cheap. Also it's impossible to get dog hair off it. I swear it just collects it. I don't recommend if you have pets. I'll be looking for a different one as it's saggy in the sides and just doesn't look how I was expecting. Maybe it will fit your couch better. Very thin material. Can see through in the lighting. Not water resistant.
